rec.name: PDP Product Attributes (Customer Rating Scales)
rec.status: Built — delivered to client; hidden in the live theme until go-live (client feedback pending)

what.text: A buy-box block titled e.g. "What our customers say". It sits in a rounded, light-grey card directly under the price and review stars. Inside are several attribute rows (Look, Feeling, Vibe). Each row has a title, a thin progress/slider bar with a pink marker, and scale labels underneath (e.g. 'not good / good / very good', 'short-lived / long-lasting'). The content is defined per product. Note: the ticket is a Sectionfy order of 5 sections (Info Buttons, Video Play Button, Testimonial Videos, Multiple Product Videos, Product Attributes). This record covers only Product Attributes, because it is the best-documented one. Multiple Product Videos is a separate element that should get its own record.

why.text: Aggregated customer perception shown as simple scales gives quick, scannable social proof right next to the price and CTA. Shoppers see how the product feels or performs (e.g. 'sleeps better', 'fuller hair') without reading reviews. This reduces uncertainty at the decision point. The product-specific scales also make the proof feel credible and relevant.

how.text: 1) Create a metaobject definition (heading plus Title 01..n, Progress 01..n as a 0–100 value, Attributes 01..n as scale labels separated by '•'). 2) Create one metaobject entry per product or product group and set its status to ACTIVE. While it was Draft, nothing appeared on the storefront. 3) Add a product metafield that references the metaobject so the content is chosen per product, not identical on every PDP. 4) Add the 'CRO | Product Attributes' block to the product template in the buy box, between the price and the quantity selector/ATC. 5) Style it through the block settings. The block was added to every product template but is hidden in the live theme's customizer until launch. The ticket also gives dev effort as 20h for the whole 5-section order.

items: Heading: font size (24), weight (600), style normal/italic
Title: font size (15), weight (600), style normal/italic, position Left/Center/Right
Progress bar: track background (#FFFFFF), active/fill colour (#F9BBBB), style Rounded/Normal
Per-product content via metaobject entry (Heading, Title n, Progress n, Attributes n)

dependencies.text: Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme (here: FOCAL Theme (Sectionfy)). Needs a metaobject definition with entries set to Active status and a product metafield or reference that selects the entry per product. The Sectionfy section code must be installed in the theme. The ticket does not show the exact metafield name or type, so these are inferred.

items: Conversion rate on products with vs. without the block
Scroll depth / visibility of the block
